course.title: Solar Photovoltaic System
course.department: Department of Energy Science and Engineering

content.value:
. Design a solar PV system for a house which contains 3 fans of 70 watts each running 06   
4 hours a day, 3 rubes lights of 35 watts each running for 8 hours a day and a refrigerator of   
250 watts running for 12 hours a day, where consider compressor run 6 hours and off 6   
hours. Consider battery autonomy 2 days, DOD 50%, battery charging efficiency is 80%,   
peak sun hours daily is 6 , battery voltage is 12V.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2022
